instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show one person's answers to a form across every time they answered, in order, and the trend of one numeric answer, from the answer facts it is given", and give it form_id (The form); respondent_id (The person whose answers to read); field_map (Output field name to questionId); records (The answer-fact records, as a store lists them).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-answer-progress and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Returns one row per time answered, oldest first, with the mapped answers and when; the numeric series for the trend; the latest row; and the count. A person who has not answered gets no rows.
4. It keeps nothing: it is given the rows it works from as `records`, and answers its result for your AI to read or to write to a store.
